# AI-augmented project

> How a person, a language model and a machine are set up and run one project together: what each decides, what a session is handed, how memory is kept and audited, each rule with its grade of evidence and a check to run in CI.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Session: what the model decides and is handed

- [A task names its checks](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/session/a-task-names-its-checks.md): a task is handed to the model as a brief whose Checks part lists the commands that judge the result, each with what passing means.
- [The code takes precedence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/session/code-takes-precedence.md): the start file says once that, when an instruction or a memory disagrees with the code, the code is followed and the disagreement is said.
- [The model decides nothing unchecked](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/session/model-decides-nothing-unchecked.md): a program decides what it can check, the person decides the rest, and the model drafts and proposes without deciding.
- [Stale text is found by a program](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/session/stale-text-found-by-a-program.md): every path that an instruction names is looked up by a program on every commit, so a line that points at nothing is found, not trusted.
- [The start file holds what the code cannot say](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/session/start-file-holds-what-the-code-cannot-say.md): the start file holds the commands, the non-standard conventions, the precedence sentence and one pointer per kind of task, within a bound of lines, and no overview of the repository.

## Memory: what is kept across sessions

- [A memory file has a source](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/memory/memory-file-has-a-source.md): each memory file records its date, its type and a source that a program can follow, and a rule is a proposal until the person accepts it.
- [The memory index has one line per file](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/principles/memory/memory-index-one-line-per-file.md): the memory index holds one line per memory file, in one form and within a bound, so that a line is one fact's address and a program can count them.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
